verse.verse_2: those who, when they take from others by measure, take their full share;
verse.verse_3: but who, when they measure or weigh for others, give less than their due.
verse.verse_4: Do they not realise that they will be raised to life
verse.verse_6: a Day when mankind will stand before the Lord of the Universe?
verse.verse_7: No indeed! Verily the deeds of the wicked are in the Record locked up in the prison-house!
verse.verse_8: And how would you know what the Record of the prison-house is?
verse.verse_10: Woe, then, to those that give the lie,
verse.verse_11: those that give the lie to the Day of Recompense.
verse.verse_12: Yet none gives the lie to it except the transgressor immersed in sin;
verse.verse_13: who, when Our verses are recited to him, says: “Mere tales of olden times!”
verse.verse_14: No indeed! The truth is that their hearts have become rusted on account of their evil deeds.
verse.verse_15: No indeed! On that Day they will be screened off from seeing their Lord,
verse.verse_16: and then they shall enter Hell,
verse.verse_17: whereafter they will be told: “This is what you used to give the lie to.”
verse.verse_18: No indeed! Verily, the deeds of the virtuous shall be in the record of the exalted ones.
verse.verse_19: And what do you know what the Record of the exalted ones is?
verse.verse_21: which the angels placed near Allah to safeguard.
verse.verse_22: Verily the virtuous shall be in Bliss;
verse.verse_24: You shall see upon their faces the glow of bliss.
verse.verse_25: They will be served a drink of the finest sealed wine,
verse.verse_26: whose seal is musk – so let all aspirants aspire after that –
verse.verse_27: a wine whose mixture is Tasnim,
verse.verse_28: a fountain at which the chosen ones shall drink.
verse.verse_29: Behold, the wicked were wont to laugh at the believers:
verse.verse_30: when they passed by them they winked,
verse.verse_31: and when they went back to their families, they went back jesting,
verse.verse_32: and when they saw the believers, they said: “Lo! These are the erring ones”;
verse.verse_33: (they said so although) they had not been appointed watchers over them.
verse.verse_34: But today the believers are laughing at the unbelievers;
verse.verse_35: seated upon their couches, they are looking around.
verse.verse_36: Have the unbelievers been duly rewarded for their deeds?
